profile.name: Soham Belurgikar
profile.intro: I build distributed systems, data platforms, and intelligent search. Currently pursuing my Master of Computer Science at UIUC, after three years engineering data systems at Barclays.

projects.name: FrameSeek
projects.title: Find the moment. Not just the video.
projects.description: A search engine that brings together what’s said, written, and seen in a video. Ask a question, refine it in conversation, and jump straight to the relevant moment.
projects.detail: A learned relevance scorer improved Success@5 over OCR/transcript baselines on 300 held-out queries (temporal IoU ≥ 0.5). Checkpointed AWS ingestion handled 100+ GB of raw video with zero data loss.
bullets: Built an end-to-end multimodal search platform combining transcripts, OCR, and visual embeddings across 100+ hours of video; served results via a Go REST API at 500 ms p95 search latency.
Trained a logistic regression relevance scorer in scikit-learn, boosting query Success@5 by +8 percentage points over OCR/transcript baselines on 300 held-out queries (temporal IoU ≥ 0.5).
Engineered a fault-tolerant ingestion pipeline on AWS S3 and Batch with idempotent retries and stage checkpoints, achieving zero data loss across 100+ GB of raw video feeds.
Implemented conversational multi-turn retrieval using LangGraph and custom LangChain agents to resolve follow-up context and return timestamp-linked playback results.

projects.name: StreamForge
projects.title: From live events to ready-to-use features.
projects.description: A distributed streaming pipeline that computes and serves fresh feature vectors for ML inference, with replicated state and low-latency retrieval.
projects.detail: *Read latency measured under simulated high concurrency. Docker Compose and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring supported 99.9% uptime across cluster test runs.
bullets: Designed a distributed streaming pipeline in Go and Kafka processing 25,000+ events/sec to compute and serve real-time feature vectors for downstream ML inference models.
Implemented a Raft-based consensus mechanism in Go for fault-tolerant state replication across a 5-node cluster, ensuring consistent state updates during network partitions.
Exposed low-latency feature retrieval via gRPC microservices with Redis caching, sustaining <12 ms p99 read latency under simulated high concurrency.
Containerized the multi-service architecture with Docker Compose and configured Prometheus/Grafana alerting, maintaining 99.9% uptime across cluster test runs.

experience.title: Software Engineer

Automated data reconciliation and validation pipelines across staging and production, reducing manual verification effort by approximately 40%.
